title: Execution Observability: reconcile delivered gating removal and per-harness evidence
outcome: Remove per-turn gating: ordinary model turns never require evaluate/begin/grant or gated settlement/recovery; keep non-blocking host observations, claims and acceptance
acceptance: No ordinary model turn, queue progression, Resume or wake calls or waits on turn_evaluate, turn_begin, a grant, or any gated settlement or recovery; the turnGatedControl ON path and its setting no longer exist, and no stored or imported setting can reactivate gating

Host-observed execution, source-change and test-run evidence is still recorded to Engram after the fact through an existing non-blocking observation or verification route, and claim association keeps working; worktree association moves onto the existing ordinary binding, so nothing needs a control session

Turn-gating code (grant retention, retained or unknown-head recovery, admission and bind retry, containment, settlement and rebind) is DELETED from TermAl, not disabled or kept for compatibility, without erasing historical evidence, unknown prior-operation records, queued user content or ordinary delivery protections; Stop, reset, provider ownership, exact delivery, transport authorization, file and tool permissions and durable-write safety are unchanged

TermAl's source contains no call to Engram's turn operations (turn evaluate, turn begin, turn complete, the control-session bind used for turn admission, settlement, rebind or recovery), shown by a source search cited on the item and by tests, so that Engram's deletion of those operations cannot break any TermAl path, and contains no use of routing_token or any other field removed from the control-session wire, shown by the same cited source search. Passive decoding of retained historical records, redaction of legacy values, test fixtures and assertions that such a field is absent are not use: nothing TermAl sends or requires on the wire carries the field.
Focused tests cover ordinary dispatch, queue, Resume, wake and reset with legacy retained state present; the review pair and the full gate pass on the landing input

After the coordinated cutover and actual TermAl restart, the running removal build records ordinary turn outcomes and source/check facts, ordinary named-root binding, registered verification and test-credit results through Engram's active ordinary writer for Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode and Kimi; the evidence names the running builds and actual per-harness results.
The documentation item w-2aa5a4a19772 is completed against this item's final landed input
A project-level Execution Observability ON/OFF setting replaces the gated-control setting; it controls only non-blocking host observation and never gates a turn

completion.summary: Execution Observability replaces per-turn gating. Ordinary model turns, queue progression, Resume and wakes never call or wait on turn_evaluate, turn_begin, a grant or gated settlement. The turnGatedControl path and its setting are deleted; historical records stay as passive data. TermAl sends no Engram turn operation and no routing_token. The project-level executionObservability ON/OFF setting controls only non-blocking host observation. After the cutover restart, the running removal build (491dd015) recorded ordinary outcomes, named-root binding, registered verification and credit for Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode and Kimi. All 11 post-landing review Mediums are closed. The final landed input is master 0dc6c384, whose FULL test-1b819f8a passed. The documentation item w-2aa5a4a19772 is complete. The independent evaluation (delegation-656b43a4, Codex) passed all 8 criteria at revision 21, where C6's control-child sentence had been deleted on Greg's word (Fable2 #5444).
